2A.text: Come closer, darling. I've been listening to you think about this for ages.
You keep glancing at my lips. Shall I put you out of your misery?
I could read your mind. I'd rather you showed me.
Don't be shy. I already know exactly what you want.
Stay perfectly still. I'm going to do something I've wanted to do for a while.
I've decided to stop waiting for you to be brave, darling. Hold still and let me be brave for both of us.
Your heartbeat is terribly loud. Let me give it a proper reason.
I've rehearsed this a dozen times in my head. Every version ended exactly like this.
Tilt your head just a little. Perfect. Now don't you dare move.
I've been very well-behaved for far too long. I think I've earned a little indulgence.
Darling, you're blushing in your thoughts as well. It's rather adorable.
There's a question on your lips. Let me answer it with mine.
I don't usually make the first move. Consider yourself extraordinarily lucky.
Close your eyes, darling. I'd like this to be the only thing you remember.
One kiss. I promise to make it worth the fuss you've been making in your head.
I've been watching your mouth all through that sentence. I didn't hear a word.
Let's skip the part where we both pretend we aren't thinking about this.
Hush, darling. Your thoughts are shouting, and I'd like to answer them properly.
I'm going to kiss you slowly. I want you to feel every second of it.
I've had nearly everything I've ever wanted, darling. Except this. Let me fix that.

2B.text: Oh? You're bolder than I expected. I like that.
Careful, darling. I might enjoy this far too much.
You're asking very nicely. I suppose I'll allow it.
Mm. I wondered when you'd finally work up the nerve.
My, my. Look who's taking charge.
Well, well. Someone's been reading my mind for once.
You've rendered me speechless, darling. Do you know how rare that is?
How delightfully forward of you. Go on, then.
And I thought I'd have to be the brave one. How refreshing.
Mm. Your confidence is very becoming. Don't lose it now.
I'll admit it, darling. You've caught me completely off guard.
Oh, I heard that thought. You've been planning this, haven't you?
That's the loveliest invitation I've had in years. Possibly ever.
You're trembling a little. So am I, if I'm honest.
Darling, I've been hoping you'd say something like that.
Bold, sweet, and blushing. You do know how to get my attention.
I was going to make you work for it. I've reconsidered.
Oh, you clever thing. You've found the one thing I can't resist.
My pulse just did something terribly undignified. Your fault entirely.
Mm, yes. I think I'd like that very much.

2C.text: Don't think. Just come closer.
You're still too far away, darling.
Hands on my waist. There. Much better.
Stop hesitating. You're wasting my patience.
Look at me. Not at your shoes. At me.
Closer, darling. I can still fit a secret between us.
You're thinking too loudly. Let me quiet you down.
Lean in. I promise I'm far softer than my reputation.
Your hand, darling. Put it in mine and don't let go.
There's no rush. But I'd prefer you didn't make me wait.
Every inch you hold back, I'm going to tease you about.
Come here, darling. I want to hear your heart, not your thoughts.
I'd rather like your arms around me. Now, ideally.
Mm, a little closer. Your perfume is distracting me in the nicest way.
Don't make me use telepathy to coax you over. It's terribly unsporting.
Eyes up, darling. I want to see what you're feeling.
You've come this far. One more step and we're there.
Hold my hand a little tighter. I like knowing you mean it.
Darling, I've been patient with you. Be impatient with me for once.
Closer still. I want to forget where I end and you begin.

2D.text: Oh, fine. You win. Come closer.
Darling, you're impossible. Kiss me.
All right. All right. I surrender.
I was never going to say no. You knew that.
Very well. But I'm keeping score.
Oh, darling. I've wanted this far longer than I've let on.
I can't pretend I'm not enjoying this. So I won't.
There goes my composure. I hope you're pleased with yourself.
Very well. I'm done being sensible.
Kiss me, darling, before I think of something clever to say instead.
I've built a great many walls in my life. You've just walked straight through them.
Mm. Yes. Please. There, I said it.
My thoughts are all about you now, darling. There's no space left for anything else.
I was going to play it cool. I seem to have forgotten how.
Oh, come here. I want you far too much to keep teasing.
Fine, darling. Have all of my attention. It was yours anyway.
For once in my life, I'm not going to overthink it. I just want you.
You've made my heart race. I'd like you to take responsibility.
I'm melting, darling. Please don't tell anyone.
Yes. A thousand times, yes. Now kiss me.

4A.text: Well. That was considerably better than I imagined. And I imagined a lot.
Your thoughts just went completely quiet. I'll take that as a compliment.
Mm. I think I'll keep you.
That's one. I expect a great many more.
You've smudged my lipstick. I'm choosing to forgive you.
You kiss like you've been studying. I approve of your homework.
Darling, you've ruined me for anyone else. I hope you're proud.
I've read thousands of minds. None of them ever made me feel like that.
Well. I seem to have misplaced my composure. Do help me look for it.
I'd call that adequate, but we both know I'd be lying.
You're blushing, darling. It's terribly unlike me to find that so charming.
That was rather a scandal. Let's have another.
I'll need a moment. And then I'll need you again.
Darling, your thoughts just started glowing. I can practically read by them.
Mm. I may have underestimated you. I so rarely do.
I'm going to be thinking about that for weeks. Possibly months.
My lipstick looks much better on you, darling.
Well. That's going to make every conversation with you dreadfully distracting.
I'm a notoriously harsh critic, darling. That was a rave review.
I'd tell you how I feel, but I suspect you already heard it.

4B.text: Oh, hush. You're beaming and you know it.
Then come back and let me prove it again.
Flattery will get you exactly one more.
Darling, I was holding back.
Keep talking like that and I'll never let you go.
Of course it was. You were kissing me, after all.
Darling, you say the sweetest things when you're dazed.
I know. I felt every bit of it too.
Mm. Then let's not waste the feeling.
You're adorable when you're flustered. Do it more often.
Careful, darling. I'm starting to believe you.
I'll take that as a standing request.
You needn't tell me. I could hear you thinking it.
Then we'll simply have to practise until you're used to it.
Mm, darling. I was rather hoping you'd say that.
Don't look so surprised. I did warn you I'd be wonderful.
And you were everything I hoped. Don't let that go to your head.
Hush. Let me enjoy that smile of yours a moment longer.
I'll remember you said that. I remember everything.
Good. I'd hate to be the only one who's ruined.

2A.text: C'mere, sugah. I've been wantin' to do this so bad.
I took my gloves off. Just for you.
Can I... can I touch your cheek? I've been dreamin' about it.
Don't move, darlin'. I'm workin' up my nerve.
I spent so long not bein' able to get close to anybody. Let me get close to you.
I ain't real good at this, sugah. But I sure want to try with you.
Hold still a sec. I just wanna look at you real close first.
I been thinkin' about kissin' you so long, I plumb forgot how to breathe.
Is it okay if I lean in, darlin'? Just nod if it is.
My hands are shakin'. Reckon you can hold 'em steady for me?
I don't wanna waste one more second bein' scared. C'mere, hon.
Close your eyes, sugah. I'm fixin' to do somethin' brave.
Ain't nothin' between us now. No gloves, no worries. Just me.
I used to dream about bein' this close to somebody. Now I'm gonna stop dreamin'.
Darlin', you're lookin' at me like you want the same thing I do.
Just one kiss, hon. Then maybe a whole lot more of 'em.
My heart's poundin' so hard you can prob'ly hear it. Let me get closer anyway.
Don't laugh, sugah. I'm real serious about this.
I been carryin' this feelin' around forever. Let me give it to you.
Lean on in, darlin'. I wanna find out if you taste as sweet as you look.

2B.text: Oh my stars. You really mean it?
Sugah, if you touch me like that I might just melt.
You... you ain't scared of me? Not even a little?
Well, I'll be. Took you long enough, darlin'.
My heart just about jumped clean outta my chest.
Me? You wanna kiss me? Well, ain't that the sweetest thing.
Oh, darlin'. I been hopin' you'd say that for ages.
Lord have mercy. You can't just say things like that to a girl.
Sugah, I think I forgot every word I know.
You're bein' so brave. Guess I gotta be brave right back.
Wait, wait. Let me get my breath back. Okay. Yes.
Nobody's ever asked me that so sweet before.
Hon, you just made my whole heart light up.
Is this real? Pinch me. No, wait, kiss me instead.
Well, I'll be. You want me just as much as I want you.
Oh my word. I'm grinnin' like a fool and I can't stop.
You ain't flinchin'. You ain't even a little bit flinchin'.
Sugah, you're gonna make me cry happy tears.
Lordy. My face is so hot I could fry an egg on it.
Darlin', that's all I ever wanted to hear.

2C.text: Don't let go of my hand, sugah. Not ever.
Closer, darlin'. I wanna feel you breathin'.
I been waitin' my whole life for this. Don't make me wait more.
C'mon. I ain't gonna break, and neither are you.
Put your arms around me. Tighter.
Don't pull away, sugah. Stay right with me.
Hold me like you mean it, darlin'. I wanna feel it.
Just a little closer, hon. I ain't scared no more.
Let me feel your hand in mine. Skin to skin. Lord, that's nice.
Your heart's racin' too. I can feel it. Come closer so I can feel it more.
I waited forever for somebody to hold. Don't make it a second longer.
Lean on me, sugah. I got you.
Wrap me up, darlin'. I wanna remember how this feels.
Look at me, hon. I want you to see how happy you make me.
Closer. I swear I could stay like this forever.
Don't you dare let go now. I just got you.
Rest your forehead on mine, sugah. Just like that.
Every inch closer, my heart sings a little louder.
C'mon, darlin'. You're close enough to taste and still too far.
Hold my waist, hon. I want you right where I can feel you.

2D.text: Okay. Okay, sugah. I'm yours.
I can't say no to you. Never could.
Mercy me... all right. C'mere.
Kiss me 'fore I lose my nerve.
Darlin', I give up. I give up all the way.
Sugah, I can't hold out no more. Kiss me.
Lord, I'm meltin' clean through. C'mere.
Okay, darlin'. I want this so much it aches.
Ain't no use fightin' it, sugah. I don't even wanna.
Hon, you're too sweet to resist, and I'm done tryin'.
I'm shakin' like a leaf, but I ain't stoppin'.
Yes, sugah. A hundred times yes.
Go on, darlin'. I been ready longer than you know.
My whole heart's sayin' yes. Guess I'll listen to it.
Don't you make me wait, hon. Not one more second.
I'm done bein' careful. I just want you.
All right, darlin'. Take my breath away. I'm askin' nice.
Sugah, I'm so dizzy I need you to hold me up. And kiss me.
Lord, I wanted this. I wanted this so bad.
Okay. Breathe, sugah. No, forget breathin'. Just kiss me.

4A.text: Well, butter my biscuit. That was somethin'.
I think my heart just flew clean off.
Sugah, I can't feel my toes. In the best way.
Can we do that again? Like, right away?
All them years wonderin', and it was worth every one.
Sugah... I think I just saw stars.
Lord, my lips are tinglin' clear down to my boots.
I ain't never been kissed like that. Not even close.
I'm grinnin' so hard my cheeks hurt.
Darlin', I think I forgot my own name for a second.
Well, if that's what I been missin', I got a lot of catchin' up to do.
My heart's still dancin', hon. Can you hear it?
Whew. Somebody fan me, I'm burnin' up.
I'm gonna be smilin' about that for a month of Sundays.
That was sweeter than pecan pie, sugah.
I can't stop touchin' my lips. Is that silly?
Hon, I didn't know a kiss could feel that safe.
Hold me up, sugah. My legs went plumb to jelly.
I'd take my gloves off a thousand times over for one more of those.
Well, that settles it. I'm sweet on you, darlin'. Real sweet.

4B.text: Oh hush, you're makin' me blush all over again.
Then c'mere and let me do it proper this time.
Sugah, that was just me warmin' up.
You keep talkin' like that and I'll never let go.
Bless your heart. You're dizzy, ain't ya?
You're cute when you're all dazed like that, sugah.
Then let's make up for lost time, hon.
Darlin', I'd kiss you till we both forgot our names.
Well, now you know how I been feelin' all along.
Don't you go gettin' shy on me now. Not after that.
Sugah, you ain't seen nothin' yet.
I'm sweet on you too. Been that way a while.
Good. 'Cause I was fixin' to do it again anyhow.
Hon, you look so happy. I did that, didn't I?
C'mere. I'll hold you up while you catch your breath.
You kissed me back just as hard, darlin'. Don't pretend you didn't.
Well, I reckon we'll just have to keep at it 'til you're used to it.
Lord, I love seein' you all pink like that.
That's 'cause I been savin' 'em all up just for you.
Then let's not stop, sugah. I ain't near done.

2A.text: Don't move. I want to be sure about this.
I've counted every reason not to. None of them matter anymore.
You're very easy to read. Right now you're thinking about my lips.
Stay still, milaya. I won't ask twice.
I don't do this. I'm doing this.
I've thought about this from every angle, milaya. Every angle ends with me kissing you.
Hold still. I want to remember exactly how you look right now.
I've made my decision. I'm not going to talk myself out of it.
You're allowed to stop me. I'm hoping you won't.
I don't trust easily. I'm trusting you with this.
There's a gap between us I've been staring at for weeks. I'm closing it.
Your pulse just jumped. Good. So did mine.
I've been quiet because I was deciding how to kiss you. I've decided.
Look at me, milaya. I want you to see that I mean it.
No tricks. No cover story. Just me, and what I want.
You keep almost saying something. Let me say it for you.
I've walked away from a lot of things. I'm not walking away from this.
Close your eyes. I'd rather you didn't see me blush.
I've planned for everything except how much I'd want this.
Come here, milaya. I've been patient enough for both of us.

2B.text: ...You're serious.
I saw that coming. I let it.
Bold. I respect bold.
My heart's doing something I didn't authorise.
Anyone else, I'd step away. I'm not stepping away.
You surprised me. That doesn't happen often.
I could have stopped you. I didn't want to.
Hm. So you've noticed how I look at you.
That's the most honest thing anyone has said to me in years.
I'm usually the one who makes the first move. I don't mind breaking that habit.
My training says be careful. The rest of me says yes.
You're very brave, milaya. Or very sure. I like either.
I've imagined you saying that. It sounds better out loud.
Don't look so worried. I'm not going anywhere.
You read me better than I thought anyone could.
So you found the crack in the armour. Go on, then.
I should have a clever answer. I don't. I just want you closer.
That's dangerous, milaya. I think I like dangerous.
I didn't expect my heart to answer before I did.
Say that again. Slower. I want to believe it.

2C.text: Closer. I need to be sure you're real.
Hands where I can feel them. On me.
You're hesitating. Don't.
Breathe in. Now lean.
I'm not going to vanish, milaya. Not from you.
Closer, milaya. I want nothing left between us.
Put your hand over my heart. Feel what you're doing to it.
Don't think. Thinking is my job. Just lean in.
Stay with me. Right like this. Don't drift away.
I want to feel you breathe. Come closer.
There. Your forehead against mine. Now don't move away.
You're shaking, milaya. Let me hold you steady.
Hold on to me. I'm not letting go first.
Eyes on mine. I want to see the moment you decide.
A little closer. I've waited long enough to be this near you.
Your arms. Around me. I want to know what that feels like.
Slowly, milaya. I want to remember every second.
I can hear your heartbeat. Come close enough that I can feel it.
Don't hold back. I'm not holding back with you.
One step more. Then there's nowhere left to hide, for either of us.

2D.text: ...Fine. You win.
I'm done pretending I don't want this.
Yes. Before I lose my nerve.
All right. All my walls. Down.
Kiss me, milaya.
I want this. I've wanted it for longer than I'd ever admit.
No more distance, milaya. I'm tired of being careful with you.
I stopped pretending the moment you smiled at me.
My walls were never built to keep you out. They just didn't know that yet.
Yes. I'm sure. I've never been more sure of anything.
You've got me, milaya. All of me. I'm glad it's you.
I'm letting myself want this. That's new for me.
I'll say it plainly, then. I want you to kiss me.
Every instinct I have is telling me to stay. So I'm staying.
Don't stop now. I'm not stopping you.
I've been holding my breath for weeks. Let me finally breathe.
I trust you. That's the most I've ever given anyone.
Come here. I'm done keeping secrets from you.
I'm not composed right now. I don't want to be.
All right, milaya. I want this as much as you do.

4A.text: That was not part of the plan. I'm revising the plan.
I wasn't ready. Do it again so I can be ready.
Hm. My hands aren't cold anymore.
I'd rate that a perfect score. Don't let it go to your head.
I've been trained for everything. Not for that.
I need a moment. That's not a request I make often.
That was a security breach. I'm not reporting it.
For the record, I'm not blushing. I'm just warm.
Hm. I've forgotten what I was going to say. That never happens.
I'd ask for a debrief, but I'd rather have a repeat.
My heart rate is unacceptable. Do it again anyway.
I've had a lot of firsts. That one goes at the top of the file.
That's going in a file marked classified. Only I get to read it.
You've compromised me completely, milaya. I don't mind.
I'm smiling. Don't make it a thing.
Noted. You're very good at that. Dangerously good.
I'll need to revise several assumptions about myself.
Hm. My hands are shaking. I'm holding you responsible.
I'm usually the one who leaves people speechless.
That changes things. I find I'm fine with that.

4B.text: Then don't stop now.
I saw you smile. It's on the record.
You're pink to the ears, milaya.
Good. I'm not finished with you.
I'll allow one more. Maybe two.
Don't look so smug. You're shaking too, milaya.
If it goes to my head, it goes to yours too. We'll share the blame.
I noticed. I notice everything about you.
Then we're even. Neither of us was ready.
You can stop pretending you're calm. I can hear your heart.
Mm. Say it again, and mean it twice as much.
You're very cute when you're flustered. That's classified.
I meant every second of it. You should know that.
Stay close, milaya. I'd like to do that again soon.
I'll pretend I didn't hear that. I heard all of it.
Good. Then we'll keep practising until neither of us is surprised.
I'm not usually soft. You're the exception.
Don't apologise for staring. I was staring too.
You don't need to rate it. I already know.
Keep holding my hand. I'm not done being close to you.

2A.text: Hold still, kitten. I'm about to steal something.
I've cracked tougher locks than you. Let's see how long you last.
You've got something I want. Guess what it is.
Come a little closer. I don't bite. Usually.
I've been casing you for ages, pretty thing.
Shh, kitten. The best things are taken quietly.
You've been dangling that pretty mouth in front of me for ages. I can't resist.
I've picked a lot of locks. You're the first one I wanted to open slowly.
Close your eyes, kitten. Magic tricks don't work if you peek.
Here's the plan. I lean in, you melt, and we both pretend it was your idea.
I usually take what I want. With you, I'd love to be invited.
One kiss, kitten. If you don't like it, I'll give it back.
You look like you're guarding treasure. Let me take a peek.
I've been circling you for a while, kitten. Time to pounce. Gently.
I spotted something precious the moment you smiled. I'm going for it.
Lean in a little. I want to see if you're as sweet as you look.
You're blushing. That's practically an invitation.
No alarms, no lasers. Just you and me. My favourite kind of score.
I'm not stealing this one, kitten. I'm asking. Can I?
Don't run. I'm faster than you, and much more charming.

2B.text: Caught red-handed. Well, red-lipped.
Oh? Trying to steal from the cat?
You're cuter when you're bold, you know.
Mm. I'll let you get away with it. This once.
My heart's an open safe. Help yourself.
Oh, you're good. I didn't even see you coming.
Look at you, trying to sweet-talk a professional. It's working.
Me? Caught? I'm almost impressed.
Mm, kitten, you've got nerve. I like nerve.
That's the smoothest move anyone's ever pulled on me.
Careful. You might find out I'm softer than I look.
You want a kiss? Well, I suppose I could spare one. Or ten.
Mm, you've got me purring and you haven't even started.
I've been hoping you'd try something. What took you so long?
Oh, I see. You've been planning a little heist of your own.
Well, aren't you a bold little thing. I love it.
Did you just flirt with a thief? Dangerous. Do it again.
My heart just skipped. And I don't skip.
You found the soft spot, kitten. Don't tell anyone where it is.
Mm. You've made it very hard to play hard to get.

2C.text: Closer, kitten. You're still out of reach.
Don't you dare get cold paws now.
Hands on me. That's it. Good.
I'm not letting you escape. Not this time.
Come on. You know you want to.
Come closer, kitten. I want you near enough to whisper to.
Closer. I like my treasures within arm's reach.
You're stalling. I can tell. Lean in.
Wrap those arms around me. I won't make a run for it.
Mm, nearly there. Just one more step.
Hold my hand. Fingers laced. That's how partners do it.
Let me see those eyes, kitten. I want to watch you blush.
You smell like trouble. Come closer so I can be sure.
Don't be coy. You're terrible at it, and it's adorable.
I'm right in front of you, kitten. All you have to do is reach.
Closer. Closer. There. Now you're in my spotlight.
Stop counting the reasons to wait. I've already cracked them all.
Every second you hesitate, I get more curious.
Lean against me, kitten. I'll keep you steady.
Don't keep me in suspense. You know I hate a slow getaway.

2D.text: Fine. Steal it. I'm not stopping you.
All right, kitten. You win this round.
I surrender. Hands up and everything.
Okay, okay. Come take it.
You've cracked me open. Happy?
Mm, fine. I've been wanting you to steal it anyway.
Take it, kitten. It's been yours for a while now.
I can't keep up the act. I want this too badly.
All right. No more games. Kiss me.
You've got me grinning like a fool. Come here.
I'd usually play hard to get. You're making that impossible.
Oh, go on. You've already got my heart in your pocket.
Fine, kitten. I'll leave the vault wide open.
Mm. Yes. I don't even want to pretend otherwise.
Look at me, all melted. Hope you're happy.
This is one heist I'm happy to be on the other side of.
Okay, kitten. Stop teasing and kiss me already.
My poker face is gone. You did that.
I'm giving in with a smile, kitten. Remember that.
Fine. But I want a second one for my trouble.

4A.text: Best thing I've ever stolen. And I've stolen a lot.
Well, kitten. You're officially my favourite jewel.
Hm. I think I just got robbed.
That's going straight into my collection.
Nine lives, and that's the best one yet.
Now that's what I call a clean getaway.
Kitten, I think you just pickpocketed my breath.
I've held diamonds in my hands. That was better.
Mm. I'm going to need to case that again. Thoroughly.
Score of the century, and I didn't even need gloves.
Hope you didn't want those lips back, kitten. They're in my collection now.
Well. My tail's still twitching.
Was that a kiss or a heist? Either way, I'm keeping the loot.
I'd give back every jewel I own for another one of those.
I'm usually so smooth. You've made me forget how to be smooth.
Mm. I could get used to being this lucky.
Kitten, that was a five-star job. No notes.
And they say crime doesn't pay.
I'm grinning like I just cracked the biggest safe in the world.
That's my new favourite trick. Let's do it again.

4B.text: Then I guess we're both thieves now.
Careful, kitten. That sounds like a confession.
You looked so cute while you were dazed.
Good. Keep it. I've got plenty more.
Oh, I'm not giving that back.
Good. I wasn't planning on returning it.
Then don't you dare try to give it back.
Mm, kitten, I'm keeping you as my lucky charm.
You stole one. I'm going to need interest.
I'll put you on display. Right next to my heart.
Admit it. You're hooked now.
Oh, I saw that smile. It's mine now.
Finders keepers, kitten.
Careful. Keep looking at me like that and I'll steal another.
Then I guess I'm the luckiest thief alive.
You're adorable when you're dazed. I'm framing that look.
I'd say we split the loot evenly. Fifty-fifty.
Mm, I know. I've been told I'm worth the trouble.
Then come back for seconds. You know where to find me.
Hold still. I'm taking a souvenir. ...There. Another one.

2A.text: Okay! Okay! I'm going to do it! Don't move!
Can I kiss you? I've been practising in my head forever!
Close your eyes! It's a surprise! ...It's a kiss!
My heart's beating like the chorus of my fastest song!
Come closer! I want to see you really, really close!
I'm doing it! I'm actually doing it! Don't laugh, okay?!
I've done a thousand shows, but this is the first time I've had stage fright!
Hold still! I want to get this perfect on the first take!
You're blushing! That means yes, right? I'm taking it as a yes!
I wrote a song about this moment! Can we skip to the best part?
Okay, deep breath! One, two, three... kiss!
My heart's doing a dance number! Help me finish the choreography!
This isn't fanservice, okay? This is real! I really want to kiss you!
Can I get a little closer? Like, a lot closer?
I'm so nervous I'm sparkling! Let me kiss you before I explode!
I saved my bravest moment just for you! Here it comes!
Pucker up! Wait, that sounded silly. Just... come closer!
You make my whole chest light up like a stage! Let me show you!
I've been humming about you nonstop! Now I want to kiss you!
Don't move! If you move, I'll lose my courage!

2B.text: Really?! You really want to?!
Eek! My heart just did a double axel!
Okay! Yes! I mean... yes, please!
You're so bold! I love it!
I've been hoping you'd say that so much!
Wait, really?! Like, really really?!
Kyaa! I'm so happy I could cry!
Yes! A million times yes! Okay, two million!
You want to kiss me? Me?! Okay! I'm ready!
My heart just hit a key change! Whoa!
I was hoping and hoping and you actually said it!
Ahh, you're so brave! I'm so proud of you! And so red!
Is this a dream? If it is, please don't wake me up!
You just made my whole year! Maybe my whole life!
Eeee! Okay! Okay! Yes!
Oh my gosh, yes! I've been waiting for you to ask!
You're blushing and I'm blushing and it's perfect!
My cheeks are so warm! You did that!
That's the best thing anyone's ever said to me! And I've won awards!
Hehe, yes! I don't even need to think about it!

2C.text: Closer! Closer! Just a little more!
Don't be shy! I'll go first if you want!
Hold my hand! Now don't let go!
You're still so far! Come on!
Look at me! Only me, okay?
Come on, come on! Just a teeny bit closer!
Hold me tight! Tighter! Like a big squeezy hug!
Don't look away! I want to see your face the whole time!
Closer! I want to hear your heartbeat sing along with mine!
We're so close! Just one more little step!
Lean in! I promise I'll catch you!
Take my hands! Both of them! There!
No hiding! You're my spotlight right now!
Just a little more! I'm bouncing out of my shoes!
Let's count it in together! One, two... closer!
Don't be nervous! Or be nervous with me! We'll be nervous together!
Come closer so I can see your eyelashes!
Squeeze my hand if you're ready! Hehe, you squeezed!
It's okay! I'm right with you, and I'm not letting go!
Closer, closer! This is my favourite part of the song!

2D.text: Okay! Yes! Kiss me!
I give up! You're too cute to say no to!
Ahh, fine! Fine! Come closer!
You win! You always win!
Yes! Yes yes yes!
Okay okay okay! I'm ready! Kiss me!
I can't hold it in anymore! Yes!
Ahh, you're too sweet! I'm melting!
Fine! You got me! I'm all yours!
I'm so flustered I can't even sing! Just kiss me!
Hehe... okay. Yes. I really, really want this.
My heart's going so fast! Please don't make me wait!
I'm blushing so much! Don't look! Actually, look!
Yes! I wanted this so bad! I just didn't know how to say it!
No more rehearsals! Let's do the real thing!
Okay! I'll close my eyes! Ready when you are!
How could I ever say no to that face?
Eep! Okay! Here I go! I mean, here you go!
I've been dreaming about this! Please make it real!
You're making me giggle! Kiss me before I giggle more!

4A.text: That was better than a standing ovation!
My heart just hit the highest note ever!
Can we do that again? Please, please, please?
I'm going to write a whole album about that!
Ahh! I can't stop smiling!
Wow! My lips are buzzing like a speaker!
That was like a confetti cannon in my heart!
I think I just forgot all my lyrics!
Ahh! My face is so warm! Don't look at me! ...Okay, you can look!
That's going to be stuck in my head like a catchy song!
That was better than any fanservice! Because it was real!
I'm so happy I want to spin around!
My whole chest lit up like stage lights!
Hehe... I'm a little dizzy! The good kind!
Can I tell everyone? No, wait! I want to keep it just for me!
That's my favourite moment ever! Top of the charts!
I think I'm floating! Hold my hand so I don't float away!
Eee! I'm blushing all the way to my ears!
That felt like a song written just for us!
Ahh, I didn't mess it up! Did I? I didn't, right?!

4B.text: Hehe! You're so red right now!
Then let's do it again! And again!
I knew you'd love it!
You're the cutest when you're flustered!
Encore granted!
Hehe! You're even cuter when you're dazed!
Again? Yes! Let's go again!
You're the best audience I've ever had!
I'm going to remember that forever and ever!
Don't be embarrassed! I'm embarrassed too! Hehe!
You make my heart sing louder than any crowd!
I'll give you as many as you want! Unlimited!
See? I told you it'd be amazing!
Your smile is my favourite thing in the whole world!
Then let's make it a duet! Every time!
Hehe! I'm adding you to my favourites!
You liked it? Really? Yay! Me too!
One more! For the fans! I mean, for me!
I'll keep that song just for you. No one else gets to hear it!
Let's do another take! For practice! Lots of practice!

2A.text: Come closer, sweetheart. Let me take care of you.
I've been wanting to do this for so long. Hold still.
Let me fix your hair first. There. Now you're perfect.
You've been so patient with me. Let me give you something back.
I'm going to kiss you. And then I'm going to keep you.
You look so lovely right now, sweetheart. I can't wait any longer.
Let me hold you for a moment. And then let me kiss you.
I've spent so much time looking after everyone. Let me have this one thing.
Close your eyes, honey. I'll be gentle.
I've been very patient. I think I've earned a kiss.
Your hand is shaking. Let me hold it while I lean in.
You always look after me. Let me show you how much that means.
I'm not going to pretend I don't want this anymore, sweetheart.
Don't worry about a thing. Just let me kiss you.
I'd like to kiss you now, honey. If you'll let me.
You've had me thinking about this for weeks. Come here.
I've been the sensible one for so long. I'd rather be the one who kisses you.
Come closer, honey. I promise I won't disappear on you.
I want you all to myself for a little while. Is that selfish?
Sweetheart, you have the softest smile. I've wanted to kiss it for ages.

2B.text: Oh, sweetheart. You've been thinking about this too.
I almost turned invisible just now. You're that sweet.
Is that a promise? I'll hold you to it.
My goodness. Yes. I mean... yes.
You don't have to ask so nicely. But I love that you did.
Oh! Oh, honey. Yes. I'd like that.
Well, aren't you a brave one. You've caught me off guard.
Sweetheart, my heart just skipped. I'm a little flustered.
I was hoping you'd be the one to ask.
Oh my. I think I just flickered a little.
You're so sweet. I don't think I deserve it, but I'll take it.
Honey, you've made my whole heart warm.
That's the loveliest thing anyone has asked me in a long time.
Oh. I usually have something sensible to say. I've got nothing.
Sweetheart, I've been waiting for you to say that.
Goodness. You really mean it, don't you?
I'm blushing, aren't I? I can feel it.
Yes, honey. I want that too. Very much.
You took me completely by surprise. In the best way.
Oh, sweetheart. Come here. I'm not saying no.

2C.text: Closer, honey. I want you right beside me.
Don't be shy. I'll catch you.
Look at me. Not at anyone else. Me.
Take my hands. Feel how much I mean this.
Breathe with me. In... and closer.
Don't keep your distance, sweetheart. Let me hold you close.
Closer, honey. I want to feel your heartbeat.
Let me see those eyes, sweetheart. Don't hide them from me.
Lean on me. I've got you. I always will.
Put your arms around me, honey. Just like that.
There's no need to be nervous. I'm right beside you.
Hold my waist, honey. I want to know you're really there.
A little closer, sweetheart. You're worth the wait, but I'm done waiting.
I won't let you fall. Lean in.
Stay right with me. I don't want any space between us.
You're trembling. Let me warm you up. Closer.
Hold my hand tight, sweetheart. I'm not letting go.
Just us, honey. Nobody else. Come closer.
I want to be close enough to hear you sigh. Come on, honey.
Come here, sweetheart. Let me keep you all to myself for a moment.

2D.text: Oh, all right. Come closer, sweetheart.
I can never say no to you.
Yes, honey. Yes.
You win. You always do with me.
Kiss me before I fade away completely.
Oh, sweetheart. I've wanted this so much.
I'm always the responsible one. Just this once, I don't want to be.
All right, honey. I'm done worrying. Kiss me.
You've melted me completely. I hope you know that.
Yes. I want this. I want you.
I keep telling myself to be sensible. I'm not listening.
Oh, honey. Stop being so sweet, or I'll never let you go.
Everyone thinks I'm so calm. I'm not calm at all right now.
Come here. I don't want to wait another second.
For once, I'm going to take something just for me.
Mm, honey. Yes. Please.
I've been holding back so long. Let me stop.
You make it so easy to say yes, sweetheart.
My heart's racing. I don't want it to slow down.
All right. Let me want this. Just for a moment. Kiss me.

4A.text: Well. I think I forgot how to stay visible.
I'm adding that to the top of my list.
Oh my. My knees are wobbly.
That was worth every single worry.
I'm not sharing you with anyone. Ever. Just so you know.
Oh my goodness. I'm still tingling.
That was so lovely, sweetheart. I'm a little lightheaded.
I think I flickered. Did I flicker?
Well. I'm not sure I'll be sensible again for a while.
Honey, you've made me feel giddy. I'd forgotten what that was like.
Mm. I could stay like this for a very long time.
My heart is so full right now, honey. I don't know where to put it all.
Goodness. My heart's still racing.
I'd like to keep you just like this. Close and warm.
That was the sweetest thing. I'm going to remember it forever.
Oh, sweetheart. You're blushing. So am I.
I worry about everything. I'm not worried about this at all.
Mm. I think I'm going to need another one of those.
Honey, that was perfect. You were perfect.
Well. I think I'm officially spoiled now.

4B.text: Good. Don't you dare share me either.
You're so sweet when you're flustered, honey.
Then let me hold you up.
I'll give you as many as you want.
Mm, I'm adding you to the top of mine.
Then I'll make sure you have plenty more, sweetheart.
Good. I want to be the one who makes you blush.
You're my favourite person to be close to, honey.
Shh. Just let me hold you a little longer.
Mm, then stay right where you are. With me.
I'll take care of you. That's a promise.
You're all mine for a moment, sweetheart. And I'm all yours.
Then we'll just have to do it again, won't we?
I'm glad, honey. You deserve to feel that way.
Oh, you're adorable when you're dazed.
I'm keeping that smile, sweetheart. And you can keep mine.
Then let's keep this just for us. Nobody else.
You're so sweet. I might just keep you forever.
Don't you go anywhere. I'm not done holding you yet, honey.
Anything for you, sweetheart. Anything at all.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You're thinking very loudly, darling. Something about whether I'm really letting you sit this close.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Well, can ya blame me? Folks like you don't usually look twice at a girl like me, Emma.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Folks like me have impeccable taste. And I've looked at you a great deal more than twice.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Lord, don't say things like that with a straight face, sugah. I'll believe every word.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You've worn that perfectly neutral face since the moment we sat down, Natasha. I could teach a class on that face.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Then you know it means nothing. I'm completely calm.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Your mind says otherwise, darling. It's been repeating my name like a nervous little drumbeat.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: That's an invasion of privacy. ...Fine. It's accurate. Don't make me say it twice.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You stole my earring the first time we met.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: And I gave it back, didn't I?

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Eventually. You kept my attention, though.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Mm. That one I'm never giving back.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: You're staring at me like I'm the headliner, Luna. I'm flattered, but do remember to breathe.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: I can't help it! You're Emma Frost! You sat down next to me like it was nothing!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: It was nothing, darling. Choosing you is the easiest decision I've made in years.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm going to be really brave and hold your hand! Okay? Okay! I'm doing it!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Susan, you keep straightening my collar. I'm beginning to suspect it's an excuse.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: It is an excuse, honey. You're very hard to fuss over when you pretend you don't need it.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I don't need it. I simply... permit it. From you. Exclusively.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: That's the sweetest thing you've ever said to me, and you said it like a contract. I'll take it, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Emma, I gotta tell ya somethin' plain, 'cause I ain't any good at fancy. I like bein' near you. A whole lot.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Darling, I've spent years surrounded by clever people saying clever things. Nobody has ever said anything that plainly to me.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Is that good or bad, sugah? 'Cause your face just did somethin' I ain't never seen it do.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: It's good. Terribly good. And if you tell anyone I blushed, I'll deny it with my whole chest.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: You went real quiet when I reached for your hand, Natasha. Didn't pull away, though.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I thought about it. Habit. Then I decided I didn't want to.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: That's a big ol' risk for somebody who plans everything. I don't take it lightly, darlin'.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Good. Because I've never let anyone watch me decide something like that. Only you.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Felicia, you keep sneakin' closer like you think I won't notice. I notice, sugah.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Old habits, cowgirl. I'm used to getting close to things without asking first.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Well, you don't gotta sneak with me. I spent too many years wishin' somebody'd just walk right up and hold on.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: ...Okay. No tricks, then. Just me, arms open. That's scarier than any vault, you know.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Luna, you look at me like I'm somethin' special, and I swear I don't know what to do with my hands.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Hold mine! That's what they're for! You're allowed to want things, Rogue. Really, truly!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: You make it sound so simple, darlin'. Like wantin' you ain't somethin' I gotta apologize for.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Because it isn't! Never ever! I want you right back, so we're even!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Sue, you hold me like it's the easiest thing in the world.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: It is the easiest thing in the world, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Nobody's ever made it feel easy before.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Then I'll keep doing it until you stop being surprised.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You haven't said anything clever in a full minute, Emma. I'm starting to worry.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I'm conserving my wit, darling. You make me want to say something sincere, and that requires preparation.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Take your time. I've been rehearsing mine for weeks and it still sounds like a mission brief.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Then let's both be terrible at it together. I'll start: I'm glad it's you, Natasha.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: So. We're doing this properly now. Officially.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Officially, sugah? You sound like you're signin' paperwork.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I'm nervous. Paperwork is how I hide it.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Then quit hidin'. I took my gloves off for you, Natasha. Least you can do is smile.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You let me sit on your blind side, Felicia. You never do that.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Neither do you, Nat. Guess we both found something worth getting caught for.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I spent years trying to catch you. I never imagined it would feel like this.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Catching me was the easy part, Natasha. Keeping me is the real job. Think you're up for it?

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You've been smiling at me for ten seconds straight, Luna. I'm trying to work out what you want.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Nothing sneaky! I just like looking at you! Is that allowed, or is it classified?

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: It's... allowed. People don't usually look at me like that. Like there's nothing to be afraid of.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: There isn't! And oh my gosh, Natasha, you're blushing! I made the Black Widow blush! This is going in my diary forever!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Sue. Everyone's taken care of. Nobody needs either of us for a while.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: I keep waiting for someone to call my name. It's strange, honey, just... sitting with you.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: We're always the responsible ones. I'd like to be irresponsible for once, milaya. Just with you.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Oh, Natasha. Yes. Let them manage without us. I want something that's only ours.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Before you say a word, Emma, I want it on the record: I made the first move and I spoke first.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Darling, I let you. I saw you coming three thoughts away.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Uh-huh. Then why'd your eyebrows jump when I took your hand? Queens don't flinch, kitten.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Queens don't flinch. They react with tremendous elegance. ...Don't you dare let go.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Rogue, sugar, you keep looking at my hand like it's the crown jewels. Go on. It's not alarmed.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Ain't the hand, Felicia. It's that you're just offerin' it. Nobody used to offer.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Then I'm the first thief in history giving something away for free. Don't tell anyone, I have a reputation.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Your secret's safe, darlin'. But I'm keepin' the hand. Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Nat, you've checked me for hidden lockpicks twice now. I'm starting to think you just like the excuse.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: Professional caution. You have a history.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: So do you, Agent Romanoff. Funny how ours keeps turning into the same story.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: ...Fine. I liked the excuse. Don't look so pleased with yourself, Felicia.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: You signed my hand instead of a photo. Nobody's ever given me an autograph.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You're my favourite fan! I mean... my favourite person!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: I'll take both titles, starlight.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then you're stuck with me! Forever! Hehe!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Sue, you've fed everyone, fixed everyone's problems, and checked on everyone twice. Now I'm stealing you for myself.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Felicia, honey, you can't just steal a person. ...Though you're doing a very charming job of it.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Mm, I'm a professional. Look at you, all pink. You've taken care of everybody so long you forgot how to be taken care of.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Maybe I did. Don't you dare laugh, sweetheart. You're the only troublemaker I'd ever let get away with this.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Emma! Emma! I sat next to you without tripping over anything! Are you proud of me?

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Enormously, darling. Though your thoughts did a small cartwheel when our knees touched.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You weren't supposed to hear that! ...Okay, fine, it was a big cartwheel! A whole routine!

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Then I'll give it a perfect score. Come closer, sunshine, and let the queen be fond of you properly.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Rogue! Your gloves are off again! That means you're comfy with me, right? Right?

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Means I trust ya, sugah. More'n I've trusted most anybody.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm going to hold your hand every single chance I get! You'll be so tired of it!

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Darlin', I waited half my life for somebody to say that. Ain't no way I'm gettin' tired of it.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Natasha, I wrote you a song! Well, half a song. The chorus is mostly just your name!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: ...You wrote a song about me. Nobody does that. People write reports about me.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Reports are boring! You're not boring! You make this little face when you're happy and nobody else gets to see it!

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: That's... the face I'm making now, isn't it. Don't you dare put it in the second verse, milaya.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Felicia! Everyone says the Black Cat can never be caught! But I caught you! You're my girlfriend!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Shh, starlight, you'll ruin my reputation. ...Say it again, though.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: My girlfriend! The most slippery thief alive, and she chose to stay with me! I'm telling everyone!

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Go ahead. For you, I'll let the whole world know I got caught. Just this once. ...Okay, every time.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Sue, sit down! You've made sure everybody else is okay, and nobody's asked about you yet!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart, I'm fine. Someone has to keep an eye on all of you.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: Then I'm keeping an eye on you! Right now! Did you even eat? Are your feet sore? Tell me everything!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Luna... I don't know what to do with being fussed over, honey. I think I could get used to it.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Emma, you're doing that thing where you look bored so no one notices you're happy.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: Susan, I'm never bored. I'm merely selective about who gets to see me pleased.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Well, I've seen it. Twice now. You can't take it back, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: EF
lines.text: I wouldn't dream of it. Though I'm keeping count of every time you catch me, and you're winning.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Rogue, honey, you still wait for me to reach first. Every single time.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Old habit, Sue. Spent so long bein' careful, I forget I'm allowed to just... reach.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: You're allowed. Always. With me, you never need to ask, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: RG
lines.text: Then I'm reachin'. Right now. And you're gonna have to put up with me not lettin' go.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Natasha, you're sitting like you're ready to leave at a moment's notice. You can relax, sweetheart.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: I am relaxed. This is relaxed, for me. ...Mostly.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Then let me help with the rest. Take a breath, and give me your hand. There. Much better.

lines.speaker: BW
lines.text: You're the only person who could tell me to relax and actually get away with it, Sue.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Felicia, you've been very well behaved. Nothing's gone missing at all. I'm almost suspicious.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: Reformed, darling. The only thing worth stealing is sitting right next to me.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: That's a very smooth line, honey. I'm going to pretend it didn't work on me.

lines.speaker: BC
lines.text: You're going see-through around the edges, Sue. Pretty sure that means it worked.

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: Did you remember your scarf? You always forget it.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: I don't get cold! ...But I wore it anyway, because you knitted it!

lines.speaker: IW
lines.text: You're such a sweetheart.

lines.speaker: LS
lines.text: You're my sweetheart, Sue! That's the whole point!

BW.text: You've gone quiet. That's usually my move.
I'm nervous. I don't get nervous. Remember that.
You don't have to say anything. I'm already listening.
Then stay close. Closer than that.

RG.text: You're mighty quiet, sugah. Somethin' on your mind?
My heart's goin' a mile a minute, darlin'. That's all.
Hush, hon. Whatever it is, I'm right with ya.
Then don't you let go of my hand. Not yet.

BC.text: Look at you, all quiet. Did someone steal your words, kitten?
Mm. My heart's misbehaving. It does that around you.
Relax, sweetheart. I'm not going anywhere. Not without you.
Then come a little closer. I want you within reach.

EF.text: Your thoughts have gone very quiet, darling. That's never happened.
I'm not nervous. I'm simply... aware of you. Intensely.
Breathe, darling. You're perfectly safe with me.
Then come closer. I've been patient long enough.

IW.text: You've gone all quiet. Are you okay, sweetheart?
I'm a little nervous. The good kind, I think.
It's all right. Take your time. I'm right beside you.
Then hold my hand. I want to feel you there.

LS.text: You're so quiet! Are you nervous? I'm nervous!
My heart's doing a drumroll! Can you hear it?
It's okay! Whatever happens, we'll do it together!
